title: He Dumped Her... So She Tried to End the World

segments.text: Meet Thom. He has one dream: to be awesome in space. And he has one girlfriend, Celia, a robotics genius with a robot hand. Guess which one he picks.
Smooth, Thom. Real smooth. Celia dumps him on the spot, and somewhere, a robot quietly saves that memory. That will not be a problem. At all.
Cut to the future. Soldiers, guns, and a ten minute window. The secret weapon? Thom. Who looks like he is about to throw up.

The plan is gloriously insane. They rebuild the breakup like a movie set and make Thom do the scene again, take two, while a machine overwrites the memory. Their director even shouts acting notes in the middle of a war zone.
Then Thom goes off script, and accidentally tells the truth.
Oh, did we mention? Celia is the one destroying the world. The take collapses, everyone screams, and finally she says what this was always about.
Two words, years too late. The director calls it a good ad-lib. With the overwrite at ninety percent and the soldiers begging to abort, Thom delivers the best line of his life.
Memory overwrite complete. Heart repaired, world saved. Lesson learned? Eh. It could have gone worse.
